item.title: Microsoft warns attackers can secretly manipulate AI recommendations
item.description: Microsoft has warned of a new tactic called AI Recommendation Poisoning, where hidden instructions inside links can manipulate an assistant’s memory and bias future recommendations. The company advises users to review and clear saved AI memories to reduce risk.

item.title: One of the first Copilot PCs with 120Hz AMOLED is now under $900 and still holds up surprisingly well
item.description: We have found a massive 33% discount on the Samsung Galaxy Book4 Edge, one of the first laptops ever made with Copilot+ AI that still holds up today with its Snapdragon X Elite CPU, vibrant AMOLED display, and other rich features.

item.title: Helldivers 2 hackers just tried cheating the Cyberstan Major Order with "in-game exploits," but the devs cracked down — and now it's harder for everyone
item.description: After Helldivers 2 cheaters used "in-game exploits" to try and get an easy Major Order win, the Battle for Cyberstan just became harder. Thanks, "dissidents."

item.title: Quality Thunderbolt 5 docks don't get any cheaper than this — Wavlink's new Thunderlight station is an easy recommendation at full price, never mind this limited-time deal
item.description: Wavlink's Thunderlight docking station proves that Thunderbolt 5 docks don't have to cost an arm and a leg. This limited-time deal is indeed very limited, so don't wait too long.

item.title: Xbox is quietly shutting down a pretty major console feature — here's when it's going away
item.description: Xbox is shutting down Social Clubs on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S in April 2026. Here is what is changing, what happens to existing clubs, and how players can stay connected using other features.

item.title: One of the best RPGs I've ever played just came to Xbox Game Pass, and got a free next-gen upgrade update too — trust me, you don't want to miss this one
item.description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance stands as one of the best RPGs of the last generation, and now it's on Xbox Game Pass — and with a free next-gen update, too.

item.title: Call of Duty is gifting everyone the recent Black Ops 7 event rewards after leaderboard bugs — even if you didn't play it
item.description: The recent leaderboard event on Black Ops 7 Zombies newest map, Mars Survival, was so bug-ridden that all players will get the rewards.

item.title: What's the best Fallout game? As Season 2 of the TV show aired, we asked you — here's what you said (and why I'm not surprised)
item.description: Which Fallout game is the best? We asked our readers that question, and the answer we got was clear — and with a few surprises in the results.

item.title: "This vertical mouse will blow your mind" — The Logitech ergo mouse I recommend to solve wrist and forearm pain is down to the lowest price of the year
item.description: Logitech's MX Vertical is the mouse I always recommend first when I hear someone complaining about wrist or forearm pain, and right now you can pick it up for a lot less than normal during President's Day weekend.

item.title: President's Day has conceived a $500 saving on this high-performing laptop we rated 4.5/5 stars — packing an OLED display and Ryzen AI 9 365 CPU
item.description: President's Day is drawing closer, and more laptop discounts are cropping up to celebrate, like Best Buy's 33% bargain for the reliable and slick ASUS Zenbook S 16 laptop.
